gaps_found.gap: Superseded project/ tree content is publicly served and contradicts the canonical dashboard
gaps_found.detail: /project/EXECUTIVE_SUMMARY.md (compiled 2026-11-07) reports 19 CSLB records and a different recommendation order, and asserts 'UPC 402.10 requires a 12-inch access panel where a slip joint is concealed'. Canonical requirement R-08 states the opposite: 'Access-panel dimensions could not be verified from a free official code source; do not assert a fixed 12-inch rule.' /project/flagged.json is also served with the older flag register. No tracked HTML file links to either file.

gaps_found.gap: The publication boundary is not in force
gaps_found.detail: Pages API reports build_type legacy with source path / on main. The workflow stages a 23-file linked closure, but the Pages source was never switched to workflow (PUT returned HTTP 403). The live set matches neither candidate: root README.md, HYPOTHESES.md and requirements.txt return 404, while project/EXECUTIVE_SUMMARY.md and project/flagged.json are served although nothing links to them.

gaps_found.gap: Consecutive legacy Page build failures alongside successful workflow runs
gaps_found.detail: Legacy builds for caab44e, a510682 and b30f89d all returned 'Page build failed.' while the Publish overflow dashboard workflow completed success for the same commits. Two competing deployment paths are in play.

gaps_found.gap: Retired redirect stubs are split: two work, two do not
gaps_found.detail: bathroom-overflow/index.html and bathtub-overflow/index.html forward to the canonical dashboard; bathtub/index.html and trip-lever/index.html return GitHub Pages 404 even though both files are tracked in the repository.

gaps_found.gap: Flag F-08 wording is broader than the official SF.gov text
gaps_found.detail: F-08 says 'A B-2 licence is not eligible for a plumbing permit'. SF.gov lists licence types A, B, C4, C16, C20, C36, C54 and states a B license holder may apply 'after approval based on the scope of work'. B-2 is a classification within B, so the bar is scope- and approval-based, not categorical.

gaps_found.gap: The canonical estimates page carries no cost-driver table
gaps_found.detail: estimates.json keys are as_of, quote_date, rows, official_fees, analysis. The six cost drivers recorded by session 0ad9ad61 live only in the retired bathtub-overflow/data/costs.json. Cost reasoning is still available via the Cost picture section of decision-analysis.html.

gaps_found.gap: An unrelated project's evidence site is inside the canonical link closure
gaps_found.detail: docs/index.html, the archived DOE GEMS Prize Challenge evidence site, is one of the 23 linked public files, so it is published as part of this dashboard's closure. The repo/topic mismatch itself is already recorded as FL-01.
